const types=new Set(['region','location','faction','sect','kingdom','dynasty','race','system','law','history','organization','building','battlefield','forbidden_area','realm','resource','environment','other']);const clean=v=>typeof v==='string'?v.trim().replace(/\s+/gu,' '):'';const arrayFields=['aliases','members','related_factions','related_locations','rules'];const normalized=$json.world_records.map((original_record,source_index)=>{const r=original_record&&typeof original_record==='object'&&!Array.isArray(original_record)?original_record:{};const arrays={};const array_types={};for(const field of arrayFields){array_types[field]=r[field]==null||Array.isArray(r[field]);const seen=new Set();arrays[field]=[];for(const value of Array.isArray(r[field])?r[field]:[]){const item=clean(value);if(item&&!seen.has(item)){seen.add(item);arrays[field].push(item);}}}const rawType=clean(r.world_type).toLowerCase();const appearanceValid=r.first_appearance_chapter==null||(Number.isInteger(r.first_appearance_chapter)&&r.first_appearance_chapter>0);return{source_index,original_record,array_types,first_appearance_type_valid:appearanceValid,record:{name:clean(r.name),world_type:types.has(rawType)?rawType:'other',aliases:arrays.aliases,parent_name:clean(r.parent_name),region:clean(r.region),description:clean(r.description),leader:clean(r.leader),members:arrays.members,related_factions:arrays.related_factions,related_locations:arrays.related_locations,rules:arrays.rules,history:clean(r.history),status:clean(r.status),first_appearance_chapter:appearanceValid&&r.first_appearance_chapter!=null?r.first_appearance_chapter:null,notes:clean(r.notes),source_chapter_uuid:clean(r.source_chapter_uuid)||$json.canon_context.chapter_uuid}}});return[{json:{...$json,normalized_world_records:normalized,supported_world_types:[...types]}}];

const valid=[];const invalid=[];for(const item of $json.normalized_world_records){const errors=[];const r=item.record;const length=Array.from(r.name).length;if(length<1)errors.push('World name is required.');else if(length>150)errors.push('World name must not exceed 150 characters.');if(!$json.supported_world_types.includes(r.world_type))errors.push('world_type must be supported.');for(const field of ['aliases','members','related_factions','related_locations','rules'])if(!item.array_types[field]||!Array.isArray(r[field]))errors.push(`${field} must be an array.`);if(!item.first_appearance_type_valid)errors.push('first_appearance_chapter must be a positive integer or null.');if(errors.length)invalid.push({source_index:item.source_index,validation_errors:errors,original_record:item.original_record});else valid.push({...r,source_index:item.source_index});}return[{json:{...$json,valid_world_records:valid,invalid_world_records:invalid}}];

const arrayFields=['aliases','members','related_factions','related_locations','rules'];const scalarFields=['parent_name','region','description','leader','history','status','first_appearance_chapter','notes'];const empty=v=>v===''||v===null||v===undefined;const map=new Map();const conflicts=[];let duplicates=0;for(const incoming of $json.world_objects){const key=`${incoming.world_type}::${incoming.world_name.toLocaleLowerCase()}`;if(!map.has(key)){const base={...incoming};for(const field of arrayFields)base[field]=[...incoming[field]];map.set(key,base);continue;}duplicates++;const existing=map.get(key);for(const field of arrayFields)existing[field]=[...new Set([...existing[field],...incoming[field]])];for(const field of scalarFields){if(empty(existing[field])&&!empty(incoming[field]))existing[field]=incoming[field];else if(!empty(existing[field])&&!empty(incoming[field])&&existing[field]!==incoming[field])conflicts.push({world_name:existing.world_name,world_type:existing.world_type,field,existing_value:existing[field],incoming_value:incoming[field],source_index:incoming._source_index});}}const worlds=[...map.values()].map(({_source_index,...world})=>world);return[{json:{...$json,worlds,world_conflicts:conflicts,duplicates_merged:duplicates}}];

## Intake
Accept and validate the WF-007 Character Knowledge contract.

## Validation
Reject invalid envelopes while isolating invalid world records.

## World Normalization
Normalize only supplied records; unsupported types become other.

## Knowledge Object Generation
Generate WLD identities and canonical objects without inference.

## Output
Deduplicate by type + name, report conflicts, summarize, and route.
